allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5288, 5173, 5432 } | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess, @{n='Process';e={\(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-Process -Name dotnet, Pos.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, @{n='Path';e={$_.Path}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; if \(-not \(Get-Process -Name dotnet, Pos.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)\) { 'No dotnet / Pos.Api process is running.' })

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($conn\) { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($conn.OwningProcess\)" | Select-Object ProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine | Format-List } else { 'Nothing on port 5173' })

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5288 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($conn\) { Get-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime | Format-List } else { 'Backend is not running \(nothing on port 5288\)' })

PowerShell($p = Get-Process -Id 15852 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p -and $p.ProcessName -eq 'Pos.Api'\) { Stop-Process -Id 15852 -Confirm:$false; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if \(Get-Process -Id 15852 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { 'Still running' } else { 'Old backend stopped' } } else { 'Process 15852 is no longer the backend; nothing stopped' }; if \(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5288 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { 'Port 5288 still busy' } else { 'Port 5288 is free' })

PowerShell($deadline = \(Get-Date\).AddMinutes\(4\); $ok = $false; while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline\) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5288 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($c\) { $ok = $true; break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4 }; if \($ok\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess; "Backend listening on 5288: process $\($proc.Id\) \($\($proc.ProcessName\)\), started $\($proc.StartTime\)"; Get-Item 'D:\\Project\\cashly-pos\\Pos.Api\\bin\\Debug\\net10.0\\Pos.Api.dll' | ForEach-Object { "Pos.Api.dll built: $\($_.LastWriteTime\)" } } else { 'Backend did not start listening within 4 minutes' })
